Frequently Asked Questions
Is the Walker rucksack water resistant without the rain cover?
The rucksack is made with PU-coated and water-repellent fabric, fine for light drizzles. In heavy rain, use the included rain cover tucked in the bottom pocket of the bag.
Which size is right for me, Walker 55L or Walker 65L?
Going for 5 to 10 days? Walker 55L works well. Planning 11 to 15 days or carrying a laptop, extra layers and gear? Go for the 65L. It gives you the extra breathing room.
Will my laptop fit inside the Walker rucksack?
Yes. The dedicated padded laptop sleeve comfortably fits laptops up to 17 inches.
Does the Walker rucksack have an aluminium frame for back support?
Yes. It has a single aluminium rod along with a hard fibre board that keeps the bag structured and your back supported during long travel days.
Does the Walker rucksack come with a day pack?
Not by default. But there is a Walker 65L + Foldable Day Pack variant on the website, ideal if you want a compact day bag for summit hikes or city days without carrying the full rucksack.

What is the difference between the Colonel series and the Colonel Pro series?
The Colonel series (80L, 95L) is top-loading, comes with a detachable day pack and a 3 year warranty. The Colonel Pro series (90L, 105L) adds a front opening zipper, larger capacity options and a 5 year warranty. Both have metal frames and rain covers included.
Does the Colonel 95L have an aluminium frame for back support?
Yes. It has an internal hard fibre board combined with an aluminium rod running along your back. This keeps the bag structured, distributes weight across your hips and shoulders evenly, and prevents back strain on long travel days or multi-day trips.
How many days of travel can the Colonel 95L handle?
Comfortably built for trips of 15 days and above. At 95L you can pack all weather clothing, a sleeping bag, shoes, daily essentials and still have room. The detachable 12L day pack is useful for shorter day excursions from your base.
How much weight can the Colonel 95L carry?
It is ideal for carrying up to 30 kg. The internal frame system is specifically built to handle heavy loads without putting excessive pressure on your spine or shoulders.
Is the Colonel 95L suitable for someone travelling by bus, train and shared cabs across India?
Yes, this is one of the most practical bags for long overland travel across India. The top loading design keeps everything secure, the 8 utility straps let you attach extra gear on the outside, and the detachable day pack doubles as a handy carry-on for overnight train journeys.
